articles.title: Jovem de 22 anos é encontrada morta com golpes de faca no pescoço em Bacabal; companheiro é suspeito | G1
articles.standfirst: De acordo com informações repassadas por familiares e pessoas próximas, o suspeito não aceitava o fim do relacionamento. A motivação e as circunstâncias do crime serão investigadas pela polícia.
articles.summary: De acordo com informações repassadas por familiares e pessoas próximas, o suspeito não aceitava o fim do relacionamento. A motivação e as circunstâncias do crime serão investigadas pela polícia.
articles.body:
Jovem de 22 anos é encontrada morta com golpes de faca no pescoço em Bacabal; companheiro é suspeito — Foto: Divulgação

Uma mulher de 22 anos foi morta com um golpe de faca no pescoço na tarde deste domingo (18), no bairro Vila da Paz, em Bacabal, no interior do Maranhão. O principal suspeito do crime é o companheiro dela, identificado como Mauricio Sousa, que foi encontrado ferido e levado ao hospital.

A vítima foi identificada como Francisca Clara Soares Santana. Segundo informações iniciais, vizinhos ouviram gritos de socorro e arrombaram o portão da residência. Ao entrarem no imóvel, encontraram Francisca morta e o companheiro com um ferimento no pescoço.

O Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) foi acionado e socorreu o homem, que foi levado ao Hospital Geral Laura Vasconcelos. Ele permanece internado sob custódia policial.

De acordo com informações repassadas por familiares e pessoas próximas, o suspeito não aceitava o fim do relacionamento. A motivação e as circunstâncias do crime serão investigadas pela polícia.

Duas facas foram encontradas no imóvel e devem ser apresentadas às autoridades para auxiliar nas investigações. Francisca deixou um filho de 5 anos, de outro relacionamento.
tags: Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência

articles.title: Homem fica gravemente ferido após perder controle de trike voador | G1
articles.standfirst: Vítima de 32 anos estava consciente, mas desorientada, e foi levada ao hospital. Ultraleve foi encontrado destruído pelos bombeiros.
articles.summary: Vítima de 32 anos estava consciente, mas desorientada, e foi levada ao hospital. Ultraleve foi encontrado destruído pelos bombeiros.
articles.body:
Homem de 32 anos ficou gravemente ferido após perder o controle de um trike voador em MT — Foto: Corpo de Bombeiros

Um homem de 32 anos ficou gravemente ferido após perder o controle de um trike voador ainda no solo, em Lucas do Rio Verde , a 360 km de Cuiabá, na noite desse sábado (17). Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, ele sofreu múltiplos traumatismos e foi encaminhado ao Hospital São Lucas.

🔍 O trike é um ultraleve pendular com capacidade para até duas pessoas, com o piloto à frente e o passageiro atrás. Nesse tipo de equipamento, os ocupantes e o motor ficam suspensos sob uma asa semelhante à de uma asa-delta, responsável pela sustentação durante o voo.

A equipe foi acionada por volta das 18h40. Conforme as informações repassadas aos militares, o homem teria perdido o equilíbrio e o controle do equipamento. Não foi informado se o acidente aconteceu durante uma tentativa de decolagem ou no pouso.

Quando os bombeiros chegaram, encontraram o ultraleve destruído. A vítima estava consciente, mas apresentava sinais de desorientação, além de ferimentos no rosto, fratura na região do queixo e suspeita de fratura no fêmur . O homem também relatava dores na coluna e tinha diversas escoriações pelo corpo.

Após a avaliação inicial, os militares prestaram os primeiros socorros e estabilizaram os membros lesionados para evitar o agravamento dos ferimentos durante a movimentação e o transporte.

O homem foi levado ao Hospital São Lucas, onde ficou sob os cuidados da equipe médica. Até a última atualização desta reportagem, não havia informações sobre o estado de saúde dele.

articles.title: Acidente na PI-215: Quatro pessoas morrem após carro bater em árvore | G1
articles.standfirst: o motorista viajava com a mulher e três crianças quando, por motivos ainda desconhecidos, perdeu o controle do veículo.
articles.summary: Um grave acidente na PI-215 deixou quatro mortos e uma criança ferida após o veículo colidir contra uma carnaúba e pegar fogo entre Campo Maior e Coivaras.
articles.body:
Quatro pessoas morrem após carro colidir contra carnaúba no PI — Foto: Corpo de Bombeiros

Duas crianças, um homem e uma mulher morreram após um grave acidente de carro na PI-215, entre os municípios de Campo Maior e Coivaras , no Centro-Norte do Piauí, na tarde deste domingo (18). Outra criança ficou ferida.

Informações repassadas ao g1 pela Polícia Militar de Campo Maior apontam que o motorista viajava com a mulher e três crianças quando, por motivos ainda desconhecidos, perdeu o controle do veículo e colidiu violentamente contra uma carnaúba às margens da rodovia.

Quatro ocupantes morreram no local após a colisão. Com a força da batida, o carro pegou fogo. Pessoas que passavam pela rodovia retiraram as vítimas fatais e a criança sobrevivente do veículo antes que as chamas se espalhassem.

O Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) foi acionado e encaminhou a criança para o Hospital Regional de Campo Maior. O estado de saúde dela não foi informado.

O Corpo de Bombeiros foi acionado para controlar o incêndio. O Instituto Médico Legal (IML) também foi acionado para realizar a remoção dos corpos. As circunstâncias do acidente devem ser investigadas.

articles.title: Adolescente fantasiado de Fofão fica ferido após cair durante apresentação em MG | G1
articles.standfirst: Jovem de 17 anos tentou fazer uma acrobacia em um muro, mas escorregou e caiu de costas no asfalto; ele foi levado ao hospital em Alfenas.
articles.summary: Jovem de 17 anos tentou fazer uma acrobacia em um muro, mas escorregou e caiu de costas no asfalto; ele foi levado ao hospital em Alfenas.
articles.body:
Um adolescente de 17 anos que trabalhava fantasiado de Fofão ficou ferido após sofrer uma queda durante uma apresentação na noite de sábado (17), em Alfenas (MG). O acidente aconteceu por volta das 21h, na Rua Dom Silvério, no bairro Jardim Boa Esperança.

Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, o jovem participava de uma apresentação de uma equipe de animação semelhante às conhecidas como “Carreta Furacão”, que reúne artistas fantasiados em performances para o público.

Adolescente fantasiado de Fofão fica ferido após cair durante apresentação em MG — Foto: Corpo de Bombeiros

Durante a apresentação, o adolescente subiu em um muro para tentar executar uma acrobacia, mas escorregou durante o salto e caiu de costas no asfalto.

Os bombeiros fizeram a avaliação e a imobilização do jovem. Em seguida, ele foi encaminhado ao Hospital Universitário Alzira Velano (HUAV), em Alfenas, para avaliação médica. Não foram divulgadas informações sobre o estado de saúde dele.

articles.title: Motorista morre após bater em poste em Amajari | G1
articles.standfirst: Quatro passageiros foram atendidos em uma unidade de saúde de Amajari e depois transferidos para o Hospital Geral de Roraima (HGR), em Boa Vista.
articles.summary: Quatro passageiros foram atendidos em uma unidade de saúde de Amajari e depois transferidos para o Hospital Geral de Roraima (HGR), em Boa Vista.
articles.body:
Acidente ocorreu na RR-203, na zona rural de Amajari (RR). — Foto: Reprodução/Redes sociais

O professor Joel de Oliveira Leite, de 42 anos, morreu após bater a caminhonete que dirigia contra um poste de energia , na madrugada deste domingo (18), na RR-203, na zona rural de Amajari , ao Norte de Roraima.

O acidente ocorreu por volta de 1h, no km 51 da rodovia, quando o motorista voltava da Vila Brasil para Boa Vista com quatro passageiros. No veículo também estava uma mulher de 50 anos e outros três homens, 28, 35 e 39 anos.

Segundo relato do passageiro de 28 anos à Polícia Militar, o professor não percebeu uma curva , seguiu em frente e bateu contra o poste de energia elétrica. O passageiro não apresentava ferimentos aparentes.

Duas ambulâncias do Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) atenderam a ocorrência. Os passageiros foram levados para uma unidade de saúde do município de Amajari e, depois, trasferidos para o Hospital Geral de Roraima (HGR), em Boa Vista.

O motorista ficou preso às ferragens e morreu no local . A morte foi confirmada pela equipe do Samu, segundo a Polícia Militar.

A perícia da Polícia Civil e o Instituto de Medicina Legal (IML) foram acionados. Após os procedimentos no local, o corpo foi levado para exames periciais.

articles.title: Acidente na GO-080: amigos de 18 anos morrem em Petrolina de Goiás | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo a polícia, jovens, que tinham 18 anos, foram arremessados do carro. Acidente aconteceu em Petrolina de Goiás.
articles.summary: Vítimas de um grave acidente na GO-080, em Petrolina de Goiás, os jovens de 18 anos foram arremessados do veículo após o motorista perder o controle.
articles.body:
Amigos morrem após acidente na GO-080, em Petrolina de Goiás — Foto: Reprodução/TV Anhanguera

Dois amigos morreram depois que o carro em que estavam capotou na GO-080, em Petrolina de Goiás , na tarde deste domingo (18). Segundo o Comando de Policiamento Rodoviário, os jovens, que tinham 18 anos, foram arremessados do veículo.

A polícia informou que o estudante Eduardo da Silva Leão teve a morte constatada ainda no local do acidente. Já Kauã Kennedy Silva Marques chegou a ser socorrido pelo Corpo de Bombeiros e levado de helicóptero para o Hospital Estadual de Urgências Governador Otávio Lage de Siqueira (Hugol), em Goiânia, em estado grave. Segundo a família, ele morreu na unidade de saúde.

De acordo com a Polícia Militar, o carro seguia no sentido de São Francisco de Goiás para Petrolina de Goiás quando o motorista perdeu o controle da direção. O veículo saiu da pista e capotou.

Os policiais informaram que não foi possível identificar quem estava dirigindo o veículo. As causas do acidente ainda serão investigadas.

Equipes do Corpo de Bombeiros, do policiamento rodoviário e do serviço aeromédico atenderam à ocorrência. A Polícia Científica e o Instituto Médico Legal também foram acionados.

articles.title: Man and woman die in two-vehicle crash near Little Stonham
articles.summary: Police say the driver dies in hospital as a result of her injuries.
articles.body:
Two people in their late teens died in a collision involving two cars, Suffolk Police said.

Officers were first called by the ambulance service to Debenham Road near Little Stonham at 10:15 BST.

Fire crews and the air ambulance were also called to the incident that involved a red Peugeot 107 and a silver Volkswagen Passat.

Police said a male passenger in the Peugeot died at the scene. The female driver was taken to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge by land ambulance, but has since died as a result of her injuries.

The occupants of the Passat suffered minor injuries, the police spokesperson added.

The road was expected to reopen later in the evening.

articles.title: Police arrest woman after auto-rickshaw driver injured in hit-and-run
articles.summary: Mumbai Khar police arrested a woman after her car hit an auto-rickshaw near Sacred Heart Church, injuring driver Naresh Shinde; traced by registration, later released on notice.
articles.body: Mumbai: Khar police arrested a woman after her car allegedly rammed into an auto-rickshaw near Sacred Heart Church in Khar West on Saturday morning, injuring the rickshaw driver. Police said the woman allegedly fled the spot without arranging medical help for the injured driver. She was later traced through the car’s registration number, arrested, and subsequently released after being served a notice.The injured driver, identified as Naresh Shinde, 46, a resident of Santacruz East, told police that the collision took place between 6.30 am and 6.35 am while he was on his way towards Lilavati Hospital in Bandra. In his complaint, Shinde said he had started work around 4.30 am and had picked up a regular passenger from Santacruz East for a trip to Parla Church in Vile Parle West. After dropping the passenger, he was proceeding towards Bandra when the accident occurred.According to the FIR, Shinde was crossing the intersection near Sacred Heart Church when a speeding car coming from the opposite direction struck the middle portion of his auto-rickshaw. The impact threw him onto the road, after which the car allegedly ran over him, leaving him trapped beneath the vehicle.A Khar police officer said several people rushed to help after hearing Shinde’s cries, moved the car and pulled him out. Shinde alleged that the woman driving the car then tried to leave the spot. He said he attempted to stop the vehicle and repeatedly asked her to halt, but she allegedly fled.After receiving treatment at VN Desai Hospital in Santacruz East, Shinde provided police with the vehicle’s registration number and other details. He alleged that the woman was driving at high speed and in a negligent, careless and reckless manner. Police said the collision also damaged his auto-rickshaw. articles.title: Speeding truck kills 30-year-old woman at JVLR junction; Driver held
articles.summary: 30-year-old Jogeshwari woman killed by speeding tempo at Mumbai’s JVLR junction; driver arrested within hours after CCTV helped police trace vehicle.
articles.body: Mumbai: A 30-year-old Jogeshwari woman was killed after a speeding tempo hit her while she was crossing the road at JVLR junction towards Meghwadi on Thursday night. Jogeshwari police later arrested driver Ramakant Yadav within three hours using CCTV footage. The victim, Lakshmi Shirkul, who worked for a private company, was returning from a birthday celebration at the Gateway of India with colleagues from her office. Around 11.10 pm, her colleague, L.G. Corea, dropped her near the northbound signal at JVLR junction. As she waited on the footpath for a vehicle to pass before crossing the road, a speeding tempo hit her and fled the spot.Corea, 34, who witnessed the incident, said, “I had dropped Shirkul at JVLR junction in my car. She was standing on the footpath, waiting for a car to pass. She was about to cross the road when a speeding tempo hit her. It happened right in front of my eyes.”According to Corea, he and Shirkul’s friend, Shilpa Rathod, were celebrating their birthdays on October 15. A few days earlier, another colleague, Sonali Desai, had informed him that their group had planned a celebration at the Gateway of India in Colaba. Shilpa, Sonali and Corea all worked with Shirkul at the same company.After the accident, Corea alerted personnel at a nearby traffic police outpost. Shirkul was taken to Trauma Care Hospital, where doctors declared her brought dead. Police said she had suffered severe injuries after the vehicle ran over her abdomen.Senior inspector Iqbal Shikalgar said the Crime Detection Squad examined CCTV footage from the area and identified the tempo’s registration number. Police then seized the vehicle, traced its driver and arrested Yadav after questioning him. articles.title: Four killed, dozens injured in major fire at Canada military base
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney said military and emergency crews fought the flames throughout the night in "some of the worst conditions imaginable".
articles.body:
Four members of the Canadian military have died and dozens were injured in a major fire at a base in the province of Alberta.

Addressing the nation on Sunday from Ottawa, Prime Minister Mark Carney described it as "one of the worst tragedies for the forces on Canadian soil in peacetime".

The fire broke out at about 16:00 local time (22:00 GMT) on Saturday at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright, one of the country's busiest military training bases, and is now contained. Its cause is still unclear, but officials said it did not appear tied to "terrorist activity".

"The nation is in mourning for those brave members of our armed forces who we have lost," said Carney.

The BBC has confirmed that Sgt Morgan Wong, Pte Shaun Farrell, Pte Aidan Goulding and Pte Hayden Lykkemark have died.

Of the 39 injured people being cared for in hospital, at least 19 are in a critical condition, Alberta Premier Danielle Smith said at a press briefing on Sunday evening.

Fire and rescue teams are remaining at the scene to contain any potential flare-ups, Wainwright Mayor Bruce Pugh told the BBC.

Members of the infantry had been conducting "high-intensity combat training with live munitions" at a grenade range and attack range, where 10 soldiers practise attacking a simulated enemy, Maj-Gen Wade Rutland told reporters at the briefing.

"There was a multitude of ordnance moving through the Wainwright training area," he said, including a grenade launcher, grenades, small arms and ammunition.

A grass fire ignited about 1km (0.6 miles) away, with the cause currently under investigation, and moved toward the attack range.

"What I would say is there was multiple training activities happening throughout the training area at the time," he said. "Uncommonly strong winds caused the fire to spread rapidly and shift direction towards the range administrative area."

Cannon fire had been heard coming from the base on Saturday before it suddenly stopped, Mayor Pugh told the BBC, noting it's not uncommon to hear cannons being fired there.

News then came through that local emergency services had been deployed to an "all hands on deck" situation.

Carney said military and emergency crews fought the flames throughout the night in "some of the worst conditions imaginable".

The people who were hurt were on the attack range and included reservists and soldiers from the Princess Patricia's Canadian Light Infantry, officials said.

In a statement early on Sunday, the Canadian Armed Forces said that "while the incident remains under investigation, at this time, there are no indications that it was the result of any terrorist activity".

Rutland told the briefing: "We do not believe this [incident] to be a result of any oil and gas infrastructure nor any outside interference".

What we know so far about deadly fire at Canadian military base

Wainwright, about 210km (130 miles) east of Edmonton, Alberta's capital, is one of the main bases used by the Canadian military for live-fire training exercises, and it houses troops from Canada and allied countries. About 690 military personnel and 300 civilian workers are on site on a typical day.

Warren Thirsk, an emergency department doctor at the Royal Alexandra Hospital, told broadcaster CBC that the number of patients involved in the incident had "completely overwhelmed" healthcare facilities in Wainwright.

The Royal Alexandra Hospital is in Edmonton, where patients are being transferred. The hospital at first declared a code orange - a disaster-response protocol for a high-casualty incident. That has since been stood down.

The provincial health agency said in a statement on Sunday that it deployed 30 units directly into Wainwright, including 22 ground ambulances, six fixed-wing and two rotary wing units.

"It is anticipated that care for patients impacted by this incident will be intensive and will add to existing high demand on acute care in Alberta," it said, adding that patients were being treated at facilities across the province.

STARS, the regional air ambulance service, said aircraft and crews from Edmonton, Saskatoon, and Calgary had been deployed.

Brandon Simmons, who lives in long-term care at the Wainwright Health Centre, told Reuters that when code orange was announced, nurses dropped everything and immediately started grabbing stretchers, gurneys and medical equipment before running to the front entrance.

Ambulances kept coming "throughout the night", he said.

"I heard people screaming inside of those vehicles that will never end up being out of my mind," he recalled, saying it was "like a scene from a war movie".

articles.title: “I want to inspire and support others”: How Caitlin Clark’s foundation backs 22,000+ students through books, food aid and safe courts
articles.summary: Caitlin Clark’s work off the basketball court is reaching children through books, food support, hospital programmes and free sports facilities.
articles.body: Caitlin Clark’s work off the basketball court is reaching children through books, food support, hospital programmes and free sports facilities. The Indiana Fever star’s foundation has backed a 22,000-book donation, helped raise more than $300,000 through a food donation campaign and supported children receiving hospital care. Its work focuses on three areas: education, nutrition and sports. From Des Moines, Iowa, to Indianapolis, Indiana, these projects aim to give young people more chances to learn, stay healthy and take part in sports, regardless of their family’s financial situation.How has Caitlin Clark turned her basketball success into support for children?Caitlin Clark’s rise from a young basketball player in Iowa to one of the WNBA’s biggest stars has given her a platform to support young people. Through the Caitlin Clark Foundation, she is directing attention and resources towards needs that go beyond basketball, including access to books, healthy food and places to play.The foundation’s mission is built around three areas: education, nutrition and sports. Each addresses a different challenge faced by children and families. Access to books can support learning, food assistance can help families meet everyday needs, and safe sports facilities can give young people a place to exercise and build friendships.Clark has also used the number 22, which she wears on her jersey, as a theme for several donations. The foundation has announced grants of $22,000 to organisations supporting children and families in Iowa. These gifts have included support for Blank Children’s Hospital in Des Moines, the Coralville Community Food Pantry and children’s services at the University of Iowa.The approach links Clark’s success in basketball with practical support for communities. Rather than focusing only on large public donations, the foundation works with local organisations that already understand the needs of the children and families they serve.What has Caitlin Clark’s foundation done to fight childhood hunger and improve access to books?Food support has been one of the foundation’s main areas of work. In March 2025, it partnered with supermarket chain Hy-Vee on a campaign that asked shoppers to round up their bills or make direct donations at checkout. The money was collected to support local food banks and pantries through Feeding America’s network.The campaign raised more than $300,000, according to the foundation’s published report. The funds were intended to help local food banks provide meals to families facing food insecurity across the Midwest. The effort also showed how small contributions from shoppers could add up to a much larger sum when collected across many stores.Hy-Vee also worked with the foundation on a separate cereal campaign. Its limited-edition Caitlin’s Crunch Time cereal went on sale in 2025, with part of the proceeds supporting the foundation’s programmes. In January 2026, the foundation announced that the campaign had raised more than $100,000.These projects are part of the foundation’s nutrition work, which focuses on helping children and families access food. For households struggling with everyday expenses, support from food banks can help cover a basic need while leaving more room in the budget for other essentials.Education is another major part of Clark’s work. In January 2025, the foundation announced a partnership with Scholastic that began with a donation of 22,000 new children’s books. The books were intended for programmes reaching children who have limited access to reading material, including those in under-resourced schools.The aim goes beyond putting books on shelves. Reading from an early age helps children build language skills, improve their understanding and use their imagination. Having books at home or in school can also give young readers more chances to practise outside classroom hours.The donation gives the foundation a way to support learning through an established publishing partner. It also adds an education programme to its work on food support and sports facilities, giving the foundation several ways to reach children with different needs.These efforts are especially relevant for families who cannot easily pay for extra books, organised activities or other resources. By working with existing organisations, the foundation can direct support towards programmes already serving children in their communities.How are Caitlin Clark and Musco Lighting creating safer places for children to play?Clark’s sports projects focus on giving children places where they can play without having to pay for private training or join expensive sports leagues. Her foundation partnered with Musco Lighting to bring multi-sport courts to public middle schools in Des Moines.The project includes four schools: Hiatt Middle School, Callanan Middle School, McCombs Middle School and Weeks Middle School. The courts are designed for basketball, soccer and futsal, a smaller-sided form of soccer. They include goals, hoops, lighting, fencing and accessible entrances. These features allow children to use the facilities for different activities and make the courts easier to access.The project is important because a safe place to play can make a difference for children who do not have access to private sports facilities. Public school grounds can also bring sports closer to where children live, making it easier for them to take part.The partnership with Musco Lighting connects directly to the foundation’s wider goal of supporting children through sports. It is not just about helping young athletes improve their skills. Having a place to play can also give children opportunities to make friends, learn teamwork and stay active.The foundation has also worked on back-to-school projects, distributing backpacks filled with school supplies. Partners including Nike, Hy-Vee, Scholastic and Gatorade have supported these efforts. The aim is to help students start the school year with the materials they need.How is Caitlin Clark’s foundation helping children in hospitals?Clark’s work also reaches children who cannot spend their days in school or on a sports court because they are receiving medical care. The foundation’s Turning Pages, Healing Hearts programme brings books and activities to young patients during hospital stays.In 2026, the programme launched at Peyton Manning Children’s Hospital at Ascension St. Vincent in Indianapolis. It was also introduced at Blank Children’s Hospital in Des Moines and University of Iowa Health Care Stead Family Children’s Hospital in Iowa City.The programme includes book vending machines, activity packs and opportunities for children to choose books of their own. Patients can earn tokens through activities and milestones during their care, then use them to select a book to keep.For children spending time in hospital, this can offer a welcome break from medical routines. Choosing a story or completing an activity gives them something enjoyable to focus on during a difficult period. It also supports reading and creative activities while they are away from their usual classrooms and friends.The foundation has also announced a $50,000 donation to Peyton Manning Children’s Hospital to support Child Life Services, which helps children and families manage the emotional challenges of hospital care. The donation adds to its wider support for young patients in Indiana and Iowa.Clark has explained the purpose behind her charitable work in a statement on the foundation’s website: “I started the Caitlin Clark Foundation because I want to inspire and support others, especially young people, to chase their dreams and give back to their communities,” Clark stated. “It’s about making a lasting impact and creating opportunities for those who need it most”.Her foundation’s projects now cover several everyday needs, from food and school supplies to books and sports facilities. articles.title: ‘Jaldi le kar jaao, Tiger’: Video shows seat switch as Tiger Shroff takes the wheel after attack
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff reportedly took the wheel and rushed his injured driver to hospital after unidentified assailants opened fire at his
articles.body: MUMBAI: Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff reportedly took the wheel and rushed his injured driver to hospital after unidentified assailants opened fire at his car in Mumbai’s Juhu area on Sunday evening.A video of the incident shows the actor switching seats with his driver after the firing. A woman can be heard saying, “Jaldi le kar jaao, Tiger”.Blood stains are also visible in the aftermath of the attack.Shroff’s driver, Firdaus, sustained a gunshot wound to his left hand, while the actor escaped without any bullet injuries. The incident took place near Pushpa Narsee Park, where the actor’s vehicle was targeted by motorcycle-borne assailants.Another person, an autorickshaw driver, was also injured in the firing, according to police.The video shows Shroff moving into the driver's seat after his driver was injured in the shooting. The actor reportedly took charge of the vehicle to get the injured driver medical attention.Shroff and Firdaus were taken to Nanavati Hospital in Vile Parle.
